events.title: Riverfront Summer Lunch Time Music Series with An'Letreece
events.description: Join Riverfront Wilmington for free live music at Hare Overlook Pavilion during the Lunchtime Music series featuring An’Letreece. An’Letreece is an award-winning singer, songwriter, and entertainer from Wilmington, Delaware, with more than 17 years of professional performance experience. Known for her powerful voice, soulful sound, and engaging stage presence. Additionally, she has performed throughout the region at concerts, celebrations, corporate events, and community gatherings. A longtime lead vocalist for Delaware’s premier cover band, Best Kept Soul, An’Letreece is also an accomplished independent recording artist with original music available on streaming platforms. Through Letreece Music LLC, she continues to create memorable live entertainment experiences while supporting and inspiring artists in her community.

events.description: Celebrate the end of summer with an afternoon of family fun on the Riverfront! Little Farm Petting Zoo returns on Sunday, August 30 from 3 PM to 6 PM for a special Back to School event. Families can meet and feed friendly farm animals, enjoy free face painting, and take advantage of discounts on ice cream and water ice during the event. The petting zoo will be located between Riverwalk Mini Golf and the Delaware Children’s Museum, making it easy to spend the afternoon exploring everything the Riverfront has to offer. Bring the family and join us for one more day of summer fun before heading back to school!
